entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message used to request de-registration of a UE from the 5G network.

entities.name: Extended protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for the message.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Indicates the type of security header applied to the message.

entities.name: De-registration type
entities.description: Specifies the type of de-registration being requested.

entities.name: 5GMM cause
entities.description: Provides the cause for the de-registration request.

entities.name: T3346 value
entities.description: Timer value for GPRS timer 2, used in mobility management procedures.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI
entities.description: List of network slice selection assistance information that was rejected.

entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: List of Closed Access Group information.

entities.name: Extended rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Extended list of rejected network slice selection assistance information.

entities.name: Disaster return wait range
entities.description: Wait range value for disaster return scenarios.

entities.name: Extended CAG information list
entities.description: Extended list of Closed Access Group information.

entities.name: Lower bound timer value
entities.description: Timer value for GPRS timer 3, indicating a lower bound.

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
entities.description: List of tracking area identities forbidden for roaming.

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"
entities.description: List of tracking area identities forbidden for regional service provision.
